# Delete Columns to Make Sorted.

@example Column 0 reads b, c, c and column 2 reads a, k, z: both are ordered, a repeat included. Column 1 reads o, i, x and falls from o to i.
["boa","cik","cxz"]
=> 1

@example Column 0 falls from q to a, and column 1 from s to b.
["qr","as","mb"]
=> 2

@example With one string there is nothing to compare.
["zebra"]
=> 0

# The smallest input.
["a"]
=> 0

# A single column: repeated letters keep it; one fall removes it.
["a","a","b"]
=> 0

["b","a"]
=> 1

# Identical strings: every column is constant, so ordered.
["xyz","xyz","xyz"]
=> 0

# Column 2 reads c, d, e, a: the only fall is between the last two strings.
["abc","abd","abe","bba"]
=> 1

# Column 1 reads a, c, b, d: the first pair and the ends are in order, the middle falls.
["ka","kc","kb","kd"]
=> 1

# Column 0 falls twice but is removed once; column 1 is constant.
["az","bz","az","bz","az"]
=> 1

# Columns 1, 3 and 4 (the last) are out of order; 0 and 2 are kept.
["abcde","badcb"]
=> 3

# 100 strings: column 0 climbs through a to y, column 1 does too but falls at the very end.
["aa","aa","aa","aa","bb","bb","bb","bb","cc","cc","cc","cc","dd","dd","dd","dd","ee","ee","ee","ee","ff","ff","ff","ff","gg","gg","gg","gg","hh","hh","hh","hh","ii","ii","ii","ii","jj","jj","jj","jj","kk","kk","kk","kk","ll","ll","ll","ll","mm","mm","mm","mm","nn","nn","nn","nn","oo","oo","oo","oo","pp","pp","pp","pp","qq","qq","qq","qq","rr","rr","rr","rr","ss","ss","ss","ss","tt","tt","tt","tt","uu","uu","uu","uu","vv","vv","vv","vv","ww","ww","ww","ww","xx","xx","xx","xx","yy","yy","yy","ya"]
=> 1

# 1000 columns, all out of order: more than a byte-sized count can hold.
["",""]
=> 1000

# 256 of the 300 columns are out of order: an unsigned char count wraps to 0.
["",""]
=> 256

# One string of the longest length.
[""]
=> 0

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
["a","b","b"]
=> 0

@gen 2 small
["aaa","aba","aba","aba","aba"]
=> 0

@gen 3 small
["cyrde","cloke","cnsme","cpuoe","cjgue","cukwe"]
=> 2

@gen 4 small
["aaacb","aaccb"]
=> 0

@gen 5 small
["ba","ba","bb","ba"]
=> 1

@gen 6 small
["aaba","aaaa","bbaa","baab"]
=> 2
